decisions.headline: 11岁栗原悠辉夺得亚运会《Puyo Puyo Champions》金牌，電ファミニ称创赛事最年轻纪录
decisions.summary: 電ファミニ报道，在第20届亚洲运动会《Puyo Puyo Champions》项目中，11岁的栗原悠辉夺得金牌。报道援引赛事与日本奥委会信息梳理了其晋级过程，并称他成为亚运会历史上最年轻的金牌得主。
decisions.verification: 已打开電ファミニ报道；金牌结果与选手年龄来自报道明确陈述，最年轻纪录保留媒体归因，不改写为无来源的官方结论。
decisions.reason: 窗口内发布的电竞赛事结果，具有明确结果、选手身份与赛事信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: 電ファミニ页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日12:48，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: Minecraft LIVE再公布《我的世界》新内容：英国Minecraft World将建主题酒店，Ice Caves同步亮相
decisions.summary: 電ファミニ根据 Minecraft LIVE 披露两组新增信息：英国 Chessington World of Adventures Resort 的 Minecraft World 计划在2027年开放，其中包含 Minecraft Hotel 与“Escape the Nether”过山车；游戏侧还展示了下一批内容 Ice Caves，为洞穴加入冰晶等新环境要素。
decisions.verification: 已打开同一媒体针对 Minecraft LIVE 的两篇报道；仅合并两篇报道明确转述的 Minecraft World 主题设施与 Ice Caves 信息，不重复本期已发布的 The Sift 条目。
decisions.reason: 两篇窗口内报道对应同一场官方发布会的不同事实增量，合并为一条可避免同主体重复条目。
decisions.timeNote: Ice Caves 报道发布于北京时间9月27日01:17，Minecraft World 报道发布于01:48；两篇均位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 西班牙游戏节报告以《电车炫客》为例观察当地开发生态，主办方称本作玩家已达30万
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON 发布西班牙 Game Festival 现场报告。报道介绍了当地开发者、发行商与投资方的交流场景，并以2026年推出的《电车炫客》为代表案例；活动相关发言称该作玩家规模已达到30万。
decisions.verification: 已打开 AUTOMATON 原创现场报告；本条按行业报道首次发布时间准入，只采用文章明确记录的活动背景与30万玩家发言，不采用会随时间变化的 Steam 评分比例。
decisions.reason: 窗口内首次发布的原创产业现场报道，提供西班牙开发生态与作品表现的实质信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日10:22，位于本期固定窗口内；报道所述线下活动本身早于本期窗口，因此本条归入产业报道而非即时事件。

decisions.headline: 《Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United》TGS实机：全3D重制强化剧情演出，并继承《SaGa 2》重制版部分设计
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON 在东京电玩展实机报告中介绍《Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United》：本作以全3D重制原作为基础，强化剧情信息呈现，保留“闪悟”等系列机制，并吸收《Romancing SaGa 2》重制版的部分战斗与易用性设计；事件场景采用全语音。
decisions.verification: 已打开 AUTOMATON 原创实机报告；仅采用现场试玩明确观察到的3D重制、剧情呈现、系统承袭与全语音信息。英文正式标题通过 Nintendo/Square Enix 的 title-only 查询规范为“Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United”。
decisions.reason: 窗口内首次发布的原创实机报道，包含明确的系统与叙事设计增量。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日10:36，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《三角洲行动》公布两周年后续路线图：2027年初推“围攻：瓦尔基里”，9月27日测试“爆破”模式
decisions.summary: IGN 报道琳琅天上团队的后续路线图：周年赛季“群星（Reorientation）”之后，2027年初将推出采用虚幻引擎5技术的新行动地图“围攻：瓦尔基里（Siege: Valkyrie）”；全面战场地图“摩加迪沙（The Mog）”也将引入相关技术。新模式“爆破（Detonation）”计划9月27日先在PC与移动端测试，主机端随后加入。
decisions.verification: 已打开 IGN 报道；路线图事实全部限定在其对琳琅天上团队计划的明确陈述。游戏中文名与开发团队名称采用官方简中渠道，赛季“群星”采用官方 Steam 简中公告；其余新地图/模式保留中英对照，避免自造官方译名。
decisions.reason: 窗口内发布的开发路线图，包含新地图、技术升级、模式测试与2027年计划等多个明确事实增量。
decisions.timeNote: IGN 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日17:30，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
decisions.headline: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版公布加侬多夫16秒新片段，Switch 2版梦境场景细节有调整
decisions.summary: IGN 报道，Nintendo Today 应用发布了一段16秒的新片段，展示《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版中的加侬多夫。片段中的梦境场景相较原版加入了更明显的慢动作处理；任天堂随片文字继续以加侬多夫的威胁为主题。
decisions.verification: 已打开 IGN 报道；新片段来源明确为 Nintendo Today，一手视频时长、加侬多夫出镜与画面变化均按媒体对官方片段的直接描述呈现。
decisions.reason: 窗口内出现新的任天堂官方影像素材，提供重制版画面与演出层面的明确增量。
decisions.timeNote: IGN 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月27日01:24，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.headline: 《SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada》将于2027年5月后结束在线服务，并转为离线PvE版本
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON 报道，万代南梦宫宣布《SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada》计划在2027年5月之后结束在线服务，并把游戏转为可离线游玩的PvE版本。现有在线版覆盖PS5、Xbox Series X|S与PC（Steam）。
decisions.verification: 已打开 AUTOMATON 报道；停服时间范围、离线PvE转换计划与平台信息均明确归因于万代南梦宫公告。官方产品页与简中支持信息均仍以英文主标题展示，因此不自造简体中文游戏名。
decisions.reason: 窗口内的在线服务终止与离线保存方案公告，直接影响现有玩家与产品可用性。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月26日21:54，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.reason: 《Armed Fantasia》开发中止及505 Games相关财报信息具有较高新闻价值，但本 packet 未给出媒体页面可验证的发布时间，timeRelation=unknown；底层 Digital Bros 财报一手证据也未打开。固定窗口归属无法证明，保留跟踪等待时间或一手证据补齐。

entries.headline: 11-year-old Yuki Kurihara wins Asian Games gold in Puyo Puyo Champions
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reports that 11-year-old Yuki Kurihara won gold in the Puyo Puyo Champions event at the 20th Asian Games. The report, drawing on tournament and Japanese Olympic Committee information, says Kurihara became the youngest Asian Games gold medalist.
entries.verification: The Denfaminicogamer report was opened. The gold-medal result and age are stated directly; the youngest-medalist claim remains attributed to the media report rather than presented as an independently verified official record.
entries.timeNote: The article was published at 12:48 Beijing time on September 26, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Minecraft LIVE adds a Minecraft World hotel and roller coaster in the UK, while Ice Caves also debut
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer's Minecraft LIVE coverage reports two separate additions: Minecraft World at Chessington World of Adventures Resort is planned for 2027 with a Minecraft Hotel and the Escape the Nether roller coaster, while the game itself showed Ice Caves as upcoming content with new icy cave scenery.
entries.verification: Both opened articles explicitly relay Minecraft LIVE announcements. This entry combines the Minecraft World attraction and Ice Caves updates without repeating this edition's already-published Sift story.
entries.timeNote: The Ice Caves report was published at 01:17 Beijing time on September 27 and the Minecraft World report at 01:48; both fall inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Spain Game Festival report uses Denshattack! to examine the local development scene, with organizers citing 300,000 players
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's on-site Spain Game Festival report describes networking among local developers, publishers, and investors, and highlights 2026 release Denshattack! as one example. A festival-related statement cited in the report says the game had reached 300,000 players.
entries.verification: The original AUTOMATON field report was opened. This entry uses the article's publication time as a features/industry information increment and avoids mutable Steam review percentages.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 10:22 Beijing time on September 26, inside the fixed window; the physical event itself took place earlier and is therefore presented as industry reporting rather than breaking event news.

entries.headline: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United TGS hands-on details its full 3D remake, clearer storytelling, and inherited remake systems
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's Tokyo Game Show hands-on report describes the full 3D remake as strengthening story presentation while retaining series systems such as Glimmer, incorporating some design ideas from the Romancing SaGa 2 remake, and using fully voiced event scenes.
entries.verification: The original AUTOMATON hands-on report was opened. Copy is limited to directly observed remake, presentation, system, and voice details. The official English title was normalized through a title-only Nintendo/Square Enix lookup.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 10:36 Beijing time on September 26, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Delta Force roadmap targets Siege: Valkyrie for early 2027 and a Detonation test on September 27
entries.summary: IGN reports Team Jade's post-anniversary roadmap: the Reorientation season will be followed by the new Operations map Siege: Valkyrie in early 2027 with Unreal Engine 5 technology; the Warfare map The Mog will also use related technology. Detonation is set to begin testing on PC and mobile on September 27, with consoles to follow later.
entries.verification: The IGN report was opened and all roadmap facts are bounded to its explicit account of Team Jade's plans. Chinese naming in Canonical uses verified Simplified Chinese game, studio, and season terminology while retaining bilingual labels for newly announced maps and modes.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 17:30 Beijing time on September 26, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake shows Ganondorf in a new 16-second Nintendo Today clip
entries.summary: IGN reports that the Nintendo Today app released a 16-second clip of Ganondorf in the Ocarina of Time remake. The dream sequence uses more pronounced slow-motion treatment than the original, while Nintendo's accompanying text continues to frame Ganondorf as the central threat.
entries.verification: The IGN report was opened. The new footage is explicitly sourced to Nintendo Today, and the clip length, Ganondorf appearance, and visual change are presented only as described from that official video.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 01:24 Beijing time on September 27, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada will end online service after May 2027 and transition to an offline PvE version
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Bandai Namco plans to end SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada's online service after May 2027 and convert the game to an offline-playable PvE version. The current online release spans PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.
entries.verification: The AUTOMATON report was opened. The service-end timing, offline PvE transition, and platform information are explicitly attributed to Bandai Namco's announcement. Official product pages support Simplified Chinese but retain the English main title, so no invented Chinese title is used.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 21:54 Beijing time on September 26, inside the fixed window.
